consensus_method: Tools disagree sharply on difficulty (e.g. digital marketing services 10 vs 37 vs 67). Treat difficulty as a BAND, DataForSEO volume as the conservative floor, Ahrefs/Semrush as fuller demand. The services/agency/company trio (+ firm/online/internet synonyms) is the pillar's transactional/commercial money cluster; the bare head 'digital marketing' is informational + brutal and is excluded to the blog.
takeaways: Pillar primary cluster = 'digital marketing services' + 'digital marketing agency' + 'digital marketing company' (+ synonyms firm/online/internet marketing services). Transactional/commercial, winnable.
'digital marketing services' carries the strongest commercial signal ($36 CPC in DfS).
Bare 'digital marketing' (9.9k-14.8k vol, 62-77 diff, informational) is NOT targeted on the pillar — blog territory.
Service-specific terms (seo/local seo/ppc/etc.) are deliberately NOT in the pillar cluster — they belong to the spokes (cannibalization fence).
